name: ANSI/IEEE single-phase AC-DC current converter symbol
aliases: IEEE AC to DC current converter symbol
summary: IEEE-library current converter form that turns an AC measuring current into a scaled DC signal for remote indication.
description: This converter takes an AC current, usually from a CT secondary, and produces a DC signal proportional to it for a PLC, SCADA input or remote meter. It sits in series with the CT circuit, so the CT secondary must remain closed through the converter input or a shorting link while it is removed.

The form does not state whether the output is average-responding or true RMS, the output range or the response time. Distorted currents from drives and rectifiers can be read quite differently by different converter types.
readingNotes: Treat the input as part of the CT secondary loop.
Check whether the converter is true RMS when harmonics are present.
drawingChecklist: Show CT ratio feeding the input
distinction: A current converter outputs a signal for other equipment; an ammeter displays the current itself.
